rfam.comment: This family represents a tRNA-like structure found in the 3' UTR of Tymoviruses, Pomoviruses and Furovirus. This family (in conjunction with Rfam:RF00390 add a 5'-cap) are known to enhance translation [1]. The structure of Tymo tRNA-like has been reported in PDB: 4P5J and 6MJ0 [2, 3].
